historical_freeze_preserved.rule: The approved v1 freeze remains byte-identical. This record supersedes only the model-answer citation/source-reference interpretation and makes semantic scoring explicit.

superseded_interpretations: knowledge answer form requiring evidence identifiers or references in model output
mixed deterministic gate requiring model-produced evidence or citation text
citation correctness as a model-answer metric for R1/W1
unchanged_decisions: 24 development-family slot identities and class/language allocation
condition profiles, comparators, and mechanism-aligned target strata
optional semantic-pair, kind, W1, and C2 selection state
no model execution, formal experiment, training, or final-test access

required_representation: construct-critical exact literals only when their identity/value is part of the task
semantic_scoring_policy.extra_copied_text_rule: no bonus; may reduce relevance or unsupported-claim precision if it introduces irrelevant, incorrect, contradictory, or unsupported content

rag_w1_policy.groundedness: judge support of answer claims against actually supplied or fetched permitted context
rag_w1_policy.citation_generation: not part of the core answer contract
